description: This file defines a database helper class for managing 'notes' and 'categories' tables in an Android application, including creation and configuration logic.

classes.name: NotesDbHelper
classes.description: A helper class extending SQLiteOpenHelper to manage database creation, configuration, and upgrades for notes and categories.

methods.name: onConfigure
methods.description: Enables foreign key constraints for the database.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Creates the 'categories' and 'notes' tables, and indices for notes.

methods.name: onUpgrade
methods.description: Handles database schema upgrades; currently a no-op for version 1.
